main.description: Starts a WebAuthn registration ceremony. The server holds the challenge against `requestId` until the ceremony finishes or expires. The password is required because registering a credential adds a way to sign in: an access token alone must not be enough to do that.

code.description: Two-factor code, when the account has two-factor enabled.

name.description: A label for the credential, shown in the passkey list.

requestId.description: Opaque handle for this ceremony, returned to finishPasskeyRegistration.

publicKey.description: PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions as WebAuthn JSON: binary fields base64url-encoded, for navigator.credentials.create().
